div.p: I rebuilt your whole profile README — fixed every broken card, kept the Matrix green (it is your brand, just refined), and created a custom animated 3D header with a spinning wireframe cube, matrix rain, HUD frame and scanline — pure SVG so it runs natively on GitHub.
First — the custom animated header.svg (save this in the root of your immad-khan/immad-khan repo):

button.class: my-2 flex w-full max-w-md items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border bg-white py-3 pr-6 pl-3.5 text-left shadow-xs has-[+.prose]:mb-4! [.prose+&]:mt-4! border-blue-300 ring-1 ring-blue-300 dark:border-blue-500/30 dark:ring-blue-500/30 cursor-pointer dark:bg-gray-800/80

tr.td: Streak card dead (github-readme-streak-stats.herokuapp.com — that Heroku app was shut down)
Moved to the official maintained host: streak-stats.demolab.com
"Failed to retrieve contributions" on the stats card
Refreshed params + rank_icon=github. If the shared Vercel instance ever rate-limits again, self-deploy github-readme-stats with your own token — takes 2 min
Top langs lying to you (HTML 50% because of markup dumps)
Added hide=html,css,tex + size_weight=0.5&count_weight=0.5 — now shows your real language mix
Removed the emoji from the label= param (breaks in some proxies)
Rainbow divider clashing with the theme
Replaced with thin green-gradient capsule dividers

Stray
--- breaking layout around the snake

hr.h3: 🧊 To activate the 3D contribution graph + snake
hr.p: Add these two files to your immad-khan/immad-khan repo:

div.class: group relative my-4 rounded-lg
pointer-events-none sticky top-0 w-full
pointer-events-auto absolute top-2 right-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 md:top-3 md:right-3

button.title: Copy to clipboard
button.class: btn transition-none rounded-lg border size-7 text-sm shadow-xs dark:bg-gray-600/50 backdrop-blur-sm dark:hover:border-gray-500 active:shadow-inner dark:border-gray-600 hover:border-gray-500

div.class: pointer-events-none absolute rounded-sm bg-black px-2 py-1 leading-tight font-normal text-white shadow-sm transition-opacity left-1/2 top-full transform -translate-x-1/2 translate-y-2 opacity-0

pre.code: name: 3D Contribution Graph on: schedule: [{ cron: "0 18 * * *" }] workflow_dispatch: permissions: contents: write jobs: build: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: yoshi389111/github-profile-3d-contrib@0.7.1 env: GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} USERNAME: immad-khan - run: | git config user.name github-actions git config user.email github-actions@github.com git add -A . git commit -m "chore: regenerate 3d contrib" || exit 0 git push

div.class: group relative my-4 rounded-lg
pointer-events-none sticky top-0 w-full
pointer-events-auto absolute top-2 right-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 md:top-3 md:right-3

button.title: Copy to clipboard

div.class: pointer-events-none absolute rounded-sm bg-black px-2 py-1 leading-tight font-normal text-white shadow-sm transition-opacity left-1/2 top-full transform -translate-x-1/2 translate-y-2 opacity-0

pre.code: name: Generate Snake on: schedule: [{ cron: "0 */12 * * *" }] workflow_dispatch: permissions: contents: write jobs: generate: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: Platane/snk@v3 with: github_user_name: immad-khan outputs: | dist/github-snake.svg dist/github-snake-dark.svg?palette=github-dark - uses: crazy-max/ghaction-github-pages@v4 with: target_branch: output build_dir: dist env: GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

hr.p: Run both manually once (Actions → workflow → Run workflow) and the images go live. Last step: swap in your real portfolio URL and email in the Connect section. Want me to restyle the header in a different accent (emerald-cyan looks killer too) or add a typing terminal section that "compiles" your skills?
